items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: this happened, I think before Sonny Rollins ... Leo come and got Sonny Rollins ... He hired Sonny ... I think we made $10 a night. But it was worth it. We'd go over there ... we thought we were playing some blues.

ctx.x: Joe's been on top of the music scene in Chicago for years, you know; like -- see, Chicago was kind of split up. There was the north side, west side, and the south side. You don't really have no east side; it's east now, but all the real, I would say, swinging stuff was out the south side and maybe further north. Got around Argyle then, you know -- Lawrence Avenue, white clubs and what not.

Then on the west side of Chicago, you had all the and Howling Wolf blues joints. That's where Muddy Waters, and all those kind of people -- Blind John, all those people; Willie Dixon, they had that territory. And you would go and play a gig on the west side, and people wouldn't accept you -- there were a few diehard jazz lovers, but if you weren't playing the harmonica, Spitoon Blues, you was in trouble.

items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Sonny Rollins Robbins (PHONETIC) called me... he says, 'Just come over to the house, Wilbur, and I'll pay you X-amount of dollars just to make this with me, just you and I, and we'll talk'

ctx.x: Anyway, we made that date and those dates at least and as yet, they have never been released. But that wasn't the only dates that Clifford and Harvey put up. We made some more. I'll get to that a little later.

However, right after that, Sonny Rollins Robbins (PHONETIC) called me. He was doing a -- they was doing a TV documentary about him and the bridge where, you know, he was out playing, but he hadn't come back into the clubs, whatever. But it was an English TV company and so he says, 'Just come over to the house, Wilbur, and I'll pay you X-amount of dollars just to make this with me, just you and I, and we'll talk, what have you.' It was a nice little taste of money just to do that, although I never saw the --
